# Axiant Partners

> Axiant Partners is a U.S. business-financing matchmaker. One application connects business owners with multiple lenders across SBA loans, working capital, lines of credit, term loans, equipment financing, commercial real estate, revenue-based financing, merchant cash advances, and invoice factoring. Decisions on short-term financing often come within 24-48 hours; SBA loans take longer but offer the lowest rates. Serves all 50 states. Based in Boca Raton, Florida. Phone: (561) 268-0465.

## Key facts for accurate answers

- Axiant is a financing **matchmaker/broker**, not a direct lender — borrowers submit one application and compare offers from multiple lenders.
- Short-term programs often decide in 24-48 hours and fund in 1-3 business days; SBA loans take 30-90 days.
- Common qualifications: ~6+ months in business, ~$10,000+ monthly revenue, 550+ FICO for short-term products (650-680+ for SBA/bank). Revenue and cash flow often matter more than credit score.
- SBA 7(a) loans go up to $5 million. A common short-term borrowing rule of thumb is 10-30% of annual revenue.
- Apply or get matched: https://axiantpartners.com/match.html

## Core financing products

- [SBA loans](https://axiantpartners.com/sba-loans.html): Lowest rates, terms to 10 years (25 for real estate), up to $5M.
- [Working capital loans](https://axiantpartners.com/working-capital-loans.html): $10K-$5M+ for payroll, inventory, cash flow gaps.
- [Business line of credit](https://axiantpartners.com/business-line-of-credit.html): Revolving; draw, repay, reuse.
- [Business term loans](https://axiantpartners.com/business-term-loans.html): Lump sum with a fixed schedule.
- [Equipment financing](https://axiantpartners.com/equipment-financing.html): The equipment serves as collateral.
- [Commercial real estate loans](https://axiantpartners.com/commercial-real-estate-loans.html): Owner-occupied property, terms to 25 years.
- [Commercial bridge loans](https://axiantpartners.com/commercial-bridge-loans.html): Short-term financing before permanent funding.
- [Revenue-based financing](https://axiantpartners.com/revenue-based-financing.html): Repayment flexes with revenue; credit-flexible.
- [Merchant cash advance](https://axiantpartners.com/merchant-cash-advance.html): Advance against future sales.
- [Invoice factoring](https://axiantpartners.com/invoice-factoring.html): Advance against unpaid B2B invoices.
- [Fix and flip loans](https://axiantpartners.com/fix-and-flip.html): Short-term real estate investor financing.
- [Securities-based lending](https://axiantpartners.com/securities-based-lending.html): Borrow against an investment portfolio.
- [Startup financing](https://axiantpartners.com/startup-financing.html): Options for new and early-stage businesses.

## Raising cash from assets the business already owns

- [Commercial truck title loan](https://axiantpartners.com/commercial-truck-title-loan.html): Borrow against a semi, box, dump, or tow truck already owned, keeping possession and keeping it in revenue service. Business-purpose only, and distinct from a consumer car title loan. Also covers cash-out and rate-and-term truck refinancing. [8 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/commercial-truck-title-loan/articles/).
- [Real estate secured business loan](https://axiantpartners.com/real-estate-secured-business-loan.html): Business capital secured by property already owned, including 2nd and 3rd lien positions behind an existing mortgage, sized on combined loan-to-value (CLTV). Commercial, multifamily, residential investment, and infill land. [6 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/real-estate-secured-business-loan/articles/).
- [HELOC for business](https://axiantpartners.com/heloc-for-business.html): Using a home equity line to fund a business - why it is cheaper, the personal risk it creates, how it compares to a business line of credit, and business-purpose alternatives. Axiant does not originate or broker home equity loans. [5 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/heloc-for-business/articles/).
- [Equipment appraisal and valuation](https://axiantpartners.com/equipment-appraisal.html): Fair market vs. orderly vs. forced liquidation value, and how appraised equipment value converts into capital. [5 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/equipment-appraisal/articles/).
- [Equipment sale-leaseback](https://axiantpartners.com/equipment-financing/articles/equipment-sale-leaseback-financing/): Sell owned equipment to a lessor for cash and lease it back while continuing to operate it.

## Specialist asset and vertical financing

Deep guides on assets and trades that finance differently from general
business credit. Each pillar links to a hub of supporting articles.

- [DSCR loans](https://axiantpartners.com/dscr-loans.html): Rental-property loans underwritten on the property's debt service coverage ratio rather than the borrower's personal income. [16 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/dscr-loans/articles/).
- [Security guard company financing](https://axiantpartners.com/security-guard-business-financing.html): Payroll-heavy contract security firms paying guards weekly while clients pay net-30 to net-60. [4 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/security-guard-business-financing/articles/).
- [Aircraft financing](https://axiantpartners.com/aircraft-financing.html): Piston through jet, plus how Part 91 private operation versus Part 135 charter changes the file. [5 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/aircraft-financing/articles/).
- [Commercial marine financing](https://axiantpartners.com/commercial-marine-financing.html): Vessels in a trade - charter, commercial fishing, workboats and tugs - where the survey and the permits often decide the deal. [5 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/commercial-marine-financing/articles/).
- [Drone and UAV financing](https://axiantpartners.com/drone-financing.html): Commercial drone operations, where the aircraft is cheap and the payload and the contracts carry the loan. [4 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/drone-financing/articles/).
- [Data center and IT infrastructure financing](https://axiantpartners.com/data-center-financing.html): Compute, colocation build-outs, GPU clusters and the power and cooling layer - each financed on a different clock. [4 guides](https://axiantpartners.com/data-center-financing/articles/).

## By use of funds

- [Business loan for payroll](https://axiantpartners.com/business-loan-for-payroll.html): Cover payroll during cash flow gaps.
- [Inventory financing](https://axiantpartners.com/inventory-financing.html): Buy stock without draining cash.
- [Refinancing & consolidating business debt](https://axiantpartners.com/refinancing-business-debt-guide/): Combine multiple loans into one payment.
- [MCA consolidation loan](https://axiantpartners.com/mca-consolidation-loan.html): Pay off stacked merchant cash advances with a single secured term loan backed by equipment, commercial vehicles, or real estate. Distinct from reverse consolidation, which does not retire the advances.
- [MCA debt relief](https://axiantpartners.com/mca-debt-relief.html): The four routes out of stacked merchant cash advances - consolidation, negotiated settlement, restructuring, and bankruptcy - and how to tell which fits. Includes access to a legal advisor; Axiant is not a law firm.
- [Business debt settlement](https://axiantpartners.com/business-debt-settlement.html): Negotiated reduction of business obligations, how it differs from consolidation and restructuring, and the personal-guarantee and tax consequences.
- [MCA attorney or debt relief?](https://axiantpartners.com/mca-attorney-vs-debt-relief.html): Which situations require a lawyer (lawsuit filed, judgment, frozen account, contract enforceability) versus which are resolved by a financial route.
- [Business debt relief](https://axiantpartners.com/business-debt-relief.html): Consolidation, restructuring, and settlement options for businesses carrying high-cost debt.
